verdict.rationale: Showing current connections and disconnecting or revoking a device from the host is a fair axis for a remote-access tool like TeamViewer, but the evidence pack never documents it. The closest items are adjacent: a definition of concurrent connections, admin-side central management of managed devices, and an audit log. None of these shows a live connected-sessions view on the host or a host-side disconnect/revoke control.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
